nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=70 beats='On Monday morning, Miri walks through the school gate. The henhouse sits near the playground, warm in the sunshine. She feels excited to care for the three hens all week long.'>>

<<FILL role=setup words=70 beats='Miri walks toward the henhouse and opens the door. Big brown Bess clucks hello. Orange Pepper pecks at grain. But small gray Lucy is not in the nest where she always sits.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Miri looks around the empty henhouse. Lucy is gone. Miri feels worried but takes a breath. She must find her before Mrs. Chen arrives.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri finds Mrs. Chen watering plants. Mrs. Chen listens carefully and nods. Lucy may have squeezed through the fence gap. She gives Miri sunflower seeds Lucy loves.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri walks around the henhouse carefully. She finds a gap in the fence by the rose bushes. Chicken feathers are scattered near the opening. Lucy must have squeezed through.'>>

choices.label: Follow the feathers to the park

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri walks slowly and looks carefully around the yard. She sees a gap in the fence and gray feathers. She hears a soft cluck far away by the trees.'>>

choices.label: Follow the sound toward the trees

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Mrs. Chen walks with Miri to the park. They call Lucy softly and shake the seed bag. A girl on a bike stops and asks if she can help them search.'>>

choices.label: Search the park with both helpers
Split up to cover more ground

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri walks to the blue house next to school. An old man is sweeping his porch. He smiles and listens to her story about Lucy. He invites her to check his garden.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri follows the scattered feathers across the grass toward the park. The trail leads past the playground and into the trees. She hears soft rustling in the ferns.'>>

choices.label: Get help from a grownup first

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri walks toward the sound by the trees. The clucking gets louder. She pushes through tall ferns and finds a small clearing by a stream. Lucy is there, dusty but safe!'>>

choices.label: Approach gently and scoop her up

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The girl, Mrs. Chen, and Miri search the park together. They look under trees and by the pond. Near an old oak, they spot gray feathers and hear clucking from the bushes.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Mrs. Chen goes toward the pond. The girl checks the open field. Miri walks the fence line. She finds Lucy pecking at fallen apples under an old tree.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='In the old man's garden, Miri spots gray feathers under the tomato plants. She hears soft clucking from behind the shed. Lucy is there in a dust bath, warm and content.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The old man draws a map showing nearby yards and an orchard down the road. He offers to walk with Miri. They head toward the orchard where chickens sometimes wander.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='In the ferns by the stream, Miri spots a small shape moving. Lucy is pecking at seeds and moss. She looks happy but tired from her adventure in the wild.'>>

choices.label: Make soft clucking sounds to coax her

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri finds a woman fixing her fence nearby. She tells her about Lucy. The woman smiles, gets a long stick from her shed, and helps Miri reach the feather trail safely.'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Miri walks slowly toward Lucy, making soft clucking sounds. Lucy stops and looks up. Miri reaches her and scoops her up gently. Lucy is warm and safe in her arms.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='The three push through the bushes slowly. Lucy flaps and squawks but stays put. Miri reaches her and lifts her gently. Lucy is muddy but unharmed.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Lucy looks up at Miri and chirps. She hops over happily. Miri scoops her up and holds her close. Lucy is safe and only tired from feasting on apples.'>>

choices.label: Bring Lucy home to the henhouse

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Miri kneels down gently. Lucy hops up and waddles toward her. Miri reaches out and Lucy climbs into her arms, warm from the dust bath and so very happy.'>>

choices.label: Thank the old man and walk home

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The old man and Miri walk through the orchard. Under the apple trees, they find Lucy pecking at fallen fruit. She looks healthy and content, not scared at all.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Miri makes soft clucking sounds like the other hens. Lucy hears her and waddles closer. Miri gently grabs her and holds her close. Lucy nestles in safely.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The woman and Miri follow the feather trail to the park. By an old oak tree, they find Lucy hiding in the shade. She clucks when she sees Miri and waddles toward her.'>>

choices.label: Let the woman help pick her up

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Miri kneels and Lucy runs right to her. The old man watches with a smile. Miri holds Lucy and thanks him for his help and kindness during her search.'>>

choices.label: Return to school with the old man

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='The woman helps Miri approach Lucy slowly. Together they coax her out of hiding. Lucy hops into Miri's arms and chirps happily. The woman smiles at their success.'>>

choices.label: Thank the woman and bring Lucy home

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Miri carries Lucy back to the henhouse. Mrs. Chen is relieved and proud. The girl helps Miri fix the fence gap so Lucy cannot escape again. They become friends.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Mrs. Chen and the girl walk Lucy home with Miri. Lucy gets fresh water and grain. Mrs. Chen thanks them both. The girl becomes Miri's new best friend.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Miri brings Lucy to the henhouse. She was safe under the apple tree the whole time. Mrs. Chen laughs and gives Lucy extra treats. Miri learns hens are braver than she thought.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The old man walks Miri home with Lucy. Mrs. Chen thanks him warmly and invites him to visit. The old man becomes part of the school family. Lucy is safe and happy.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Miri brings Lucy home from the stream. Lucy shakes water from her feathers. She is muddy but unharmed. Miri learns Lucy is tougher and smarter than she knew.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The old man and Miri return Lucy safely to school. Mrs. Chen thanks him and they chat about gardens and chickens. A wonderful friendship begins under the apple trees.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The kind woman walks Miri and Lucy back to school. Mrs. Chen invites her for tea and they become neighbors. Lucy is home safe and Miri has learned the power of asking for help.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Despite searching all day, Miri cannot find Lucy anywhere. Mrs. Chen says Lucy may have found a new home or adventure of her own. Miri feels sad but learns that some journeys lead elsewhere.'>>
